name: quota-guard
description: Compacts before the 5-hour/weekly usage limit is hit, pauses until it resets, then resumes the task automatically.

threshold.title: 5-hour threshold (%)
threshold.description: Compact and pause when 5-hour usage reaches this percentage.

weeklyThreshold.title: Weekly threshold (%)
weeklyThreshold.description: Compact and pause when weekly usage reaches this percentage.

weeklyPolicy.title: Weekly limit policy
weeklyPolicy.description: pause = pause until the weekly reset; notify = only warn.

abortThreshold.title: Abort running turn at (%)
abortThreshold.description: Interrupt a running turn at this usage instead of waiting for it to finish.

graceSeconds.title: Grace after reset (s)
graceSeconds.description: Wait this long past the reported reset time before re-checking.

maxResumeAttempts.title: Max resume attempts
maxResumeAttempts.description: Stop auto-resuming after this many failed attempts per pause.

notifyAt.title: Heads-up at (%)
notifyAt.description: One toast when a window first reaches this usage. 0 disables.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Automatic quota management on or off.

testMode.title: Test / dry-run mode
testMode.description: Use simulated usage (/quota sim ...) and dry-run actions instead of real quota.

compactMinContext.title: Compact only above context (%)
compactMinContext.description: At the quota threshold, compact first only if the context window is fuller than this; otherwise just wait for the reset.
